cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

mechanism: A uses precise rota-management corrections to answer B transport and shift sacrifices with bigger coverage offers, ultimately sacrificing A trip to regain the generosity lead.
confusable: Ordinary conscientious cover meets a need; here A escalates whenever B reveals having already done more.
comparison: Food alternative expands material capacity; rota alternative increases time and personal travel sacrifice.
seedUse: Lift, covered shift, weekend and airport drive derive from D43-b; S03 adds exact handover and coverage-boundary instructions to the escalating repayment.
